sources: Holland et al. 2021 (cruise passenger risk perception)
Brooks et al. 2020 (quarantine psychological impact, Lancet)
Baygi et al. 2021 (seafarer mental health, BMC Psychiatry)
Alavi et al. 2022 (wearable alerting, Nature Medicine)
Bounded estimates from outbreak behavioral literature

notes.initial_severity_belief: Prior probability that 'something serious is happening.' ~10% reflects that most days are normal. Lower for experienced cruisers.
notes.trust_decay_per_confinement: Each confinement event erodes trust. Brooks et al.: 30% PTSD in quarantined staff → substantial trust damage.
notes.rumor_amplification_rate: How much a peer's sick report amplifies severity_belief. 2× default; higher on social-media-connected ships.
notes.severity_diffusion_rate: Per-contact probability of sharing health concern information. Higher on expedition (tight community).
